design.summary: Designed the addition of the default parameter to Table.get() (and thus TinyDB.get() via forwarding), allowing single-document queries by doc_id or condition to return a specified default value when no match is found, while preserving existing behavior when omitted.

implementation.summary: Implemented the default value parameter in Table.get() and supported it across single-document queries (doc_id and cond). Added corresponding unit tests covering all acceptance criteria.

requirements.summary: Created requirements specification for adding a default value parameter to db.get() based on issue #4.
